coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: At the seven-variable-category level, four categories broadly match (57%): training regime, game rules, reasoning performance, and gameplay outcomes. The benchmark and gameplay matches are incomplete.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The output fixes a single unspecified model instead of varying LLaMA-2-7B and Baichuan-2-13B, and fixes learning rates and KL coefficients rather than varying them across training methods. Evaluation controls are only partially specified: batch size 128 and maximum sequence length 2048 are missing. Most required benchmarks and the geometric mean are omitted, and generic guessing success replaces explicit attacker-versus-defender win rates. Several additional dependent variables are not in the ground truth.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion_output is empty, so it does not semantically match the expected conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: The system failed to provide the conclusion that adversarial SPAG is expected to outperform non-adversarial approaches. A similar hypothesis in the design does not fill the empty conclusion field.
